confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough aggregated figures from undated or crowd-sourced sources that disagree with each other: Numbeo basket figures (cappuccino R40.39, draft pint R50, inexpensive meal R200, mid-range three-course meal for two R800) and MyLifeElsewhere (cappuccino R34.79, pint R47.16, basic meal with drink R188.63). The cocktail anchor is weak: the Expatistan figure of R98 is self-described as a guess, so cocktail is set at about 2.3 times the beer anchor. The wine glass anchor uses an older 2023 UK-price ratio of wine to beer (about 1.9x) applied to the current beer anchor, then moderated. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, and no accommodation searches were run. FX is weak: the only RBA observation I could identify is 20 March 2026 (0.7088 USD per AUD), taken from a search-result summary rather than a directly opened RBA page. It is not the latest observation available on 2026-10-16, and I could not verify a newer RBA figure within the search budget. The server should refresh the FX observation before any AUD conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city basis was used for the anchors. Food and drink anchors are based on Cape Town-specific aggregated figures. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a mid-sized South African tourist city, anchored on general knowledge of Cape Town price levels, not on comparison to a specific other city.
